Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency numbers and the rollout options. We want to move the PoC forward quickly. To complete an internal technical evaluation this week, we need: a small, representative evaluation dataset (anonymized), your prompt pack with recommended prompt templates and guardrails, and a short mutual action plan (MAP) that lays out milestones to close by the end of November.

Quick details:
- Timeline target: contract signed and environment provisioned by 2026-11-30
- Usage constraints: BrightAI will only use the dataset for eval purposes and will not redistribute it outside the PoC team; we need a 6-month usage window and an option to delete after completion
- Success criteria: baseline throughput at 95% of demo numbers, no PII leakage identified in regression tests, and successful end-to-end test with our scoring harness

I've attached a ZIP with a small evaluation corpus (synthetic/anonymized) and a proposed MAP template (brightai_MAP_template.docx). Can you confirm Redwood's data licensing terms for eval artifacts and whether you require a separate MSA addendum or an internal NDA? Also please share any docs specific to prompt usage limits and evaluation-only license language.

Thanks — we can be available for a 30-min call Friday morning if helpful.

Best,

Hi Olivia — Monica from Customer Success. Echoing the timeline and adding the test checklist we’ll run during the PoC.

High-level test harness and acceptance items:
- Data ingest sanity: ensure dataset parses and anonymization checks pass (no PII tokens).
- Prompt regressions: verify recommended prompt templates in PromptPack_v2.pdf produce expected intent mapping on 1k sample queries.
- Safety regression: run our leakage detector and provide a report of any high-confidence exposures.
- Throughput benchmark: replicate the demo workload (token / sec) with identical sequence length distribution; target 95% of demo numbers for pass.
- Integration smoke: end-to-end call from BrightAI scoring harness to Redwood endpoint; verify token accounting and latency SLOs.

Deliverables we’ll provide when dataset is received:
- A short eval runbook (one pager) with commands and expected outputs.
- A sample scoring harness script (Python) and a CI job template.

If you can upload the anonymized dataset to the Drive folder we shared, we’ll pick it up today. Per Redwood policy we’ll also record the dataset ingestion step in our audit log and provide the snapshot to your security team.

Thanks — looking forward to the call Friday at 9:00am PT.

Regards,
